free_tier.stated: Lite (order page 2026-11-07): 1 Month USD 6.99/month, 3 Months USD 6.64/month (-5%), 6 Months USD 6.29/month (-10%), 1 Year USD 5.94/month (-15%); Xeon 2.90 GHz, 1 GB RAM, 20 GB NVMe, 1 Gbps port, 1 Tb traffic on the Japan default location, IPv4, VNC and SSH enabled, weekly backup. The plan card at /en/vps prints 'From $5.94' and '$5.64 with is*smart' with '2 Tb Bandwidth', so the card's From price is the 1-year term's per-month rate, not the 1-month rate, and traffic varies by location. The next tier, Start, is USD 10.19 / month with 2 GB RAM, 30 GB SSD and 3 TB. Billing terms are 1, 3, 6 and 12 months; the 1-year term prints USD 71.30 on the order summary and in the plan list (12 x USD 5.94 = USD 71.28, the difference is the rounded per-month rate). The plan is in stock: the order configurator rendered with no out-of-stock notice. No renewal price is printed on the order page, and the site has no guest cart page (/en/cart answers its Not Found (404) page), so the order page's payment-options ladder is the price a visitor can read before checkout.
